# phenix doctor

Every command on this page also accepts the [global flags](index.md#options).

## phenix doctor

Check the phenix configuration without a running server

### Synopsis

```text
Check the phenix configuration without a running server

  Prints the phenix and minimega versions, every setting with its value and
  source, one row for each check (pass, warn, fail or skip), and a summary
  with a hint for each failure (and each warning with --strict). The checks look at the config files, the
  environment, the store, phenix ui, minimega, the host tools, the disk images
  and the apps. doctor changes nothing. Run it as the user, and with the flags
  and environment, of the phenix command you are checking. It exits 1 when a
  check fails, or with --strict when one warns. For each check and its fix,
  see https://phenix.sceptre.dev/latest/doctor/.
```

```text
phenix doctor [flags]
```

### Examples

```text
# As JSON, waiting up to 10 seconds for minimega
phenix doctor -o json --timeout 10s

# Without minimega or the settings list, failing on any warning
phenix doctor --skip minimega -x --strict

# Only the problems
phenix doctor -p -x

# Output to paste into a bug report, with host data replaced
phenix doctor --report
```

### Options

```text
  -h, --help                help for doctor
  -x, --no-print-settings   leave out the settings list
  -o, --output string       Output format (text, json) (default "text")
  -p, --problems-only       show only the checks that warn or fail (the summary still counts every check)
      --report              print the output in a fenced block to paste into a bug report, with host names, addresses, user names and secrets replaced
      --skip strings        checks or groups of checks to skip, comma-separated or repeated (such as minimega or ui.jwt-signing-key)
      --strict              exit 1 when a check warns, not only when one fails
      --timeout duration    how long to wait for each answer of minimega, phenix ui or ovs-vsctl, for the store lock, and for each check that reads many files, such as disk-chains, leftovers and image-locks (default 3s)
```
